_comment: Single-guesser exploratory pool testing HistoryAwareGuesser (codenames/guessers/history_aware.py) -- wraps the exact same base as configs/guesser_pool_blend.json (weighted blend across all three spaces, noise_std=0.08) so an arena run against this pool is directly comparable to one against guesser_pool_blend.json: the only difference is whether the guesser can claim the earned bonus guess described in codenames/guessers/base.py's module docstring. Deliberately paired this way rather than combined into one pool entry, so a run_arena.py comparison isolates the effect of history-awareness specifically.
